subject: POC kickoff & hands-on routing workshop — coordinating dates and prep
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tara Lim <tara.lim@nimbushealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff + hands-on routing workshop — propose slots and prep

Hi Tara / Samir,

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock in a POC kickoff that includes a hands-on routing workshop focused on three outcomes: prompt review, routing policy design (model selection, fallback rules, regional tiering), and a short load test run to validate latency/batching.

Proposed format (2.5 hours):
- 30m: kickoff and goals alignment
- 60m: hands-on prompt & routing policy breakout (we'll bring a test harness)
- 30m: load-test window (simulated traffic)
- 30m: action items and next steps (model ops / rollout plan)

Available windows next week (PT):
- Tue 9/15, 10:00–12:30
- Wed 9/16, 13:30–16:00
- Thu 9/17, 09:00–11:30

Can you confirm which slot works or share a couple alternatives? We can also split into two shorter sessions if that helps your engineering team's schedule.

I attached a draft agenda and a short checklist for the load test (attaching Redwood_POC_agenda_v1.pdf). Laura and Sergio will join the hands-on.

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
(415) 555-0129

—Tara

Thanks — Mon 9/21 10:30–13:00 PT works for Laura and Sergio on our side and gives your east-coast folks time to join at the tail end (we'll keep the final 30m for action items). We'll update the agenda to add a short EU routing example and a fallback pattern vignette.

Two quick asks for your team before the workshop:
1) Can you share a short sample of production-like prompts or traffic patterns we should include in the load test? A CSV with ~500 rows is ideal.
2) Who will own the regional failover acceptance criteria on your side (i.e., success metrics for the load test)?

I'll circulate a revised agenda (v2) and a calendar hold for Mon 9/21. Thanks for being flexible.

-Vivek

Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on routing workshop — infra/readiness sync

Quick internal note: I can lead the load-test window and will bring a small harness that supports concurrent simulated clients and token-level tracing.

I've attached a participant checklist and a simple mapping of test VLANs we should use (participant_list.xlsx). Please confirm the names and any additional folks from Nimbus who should be invited to the run.

Also, for model selection practice, I'd like to shortlist three model variants for the session:
- mix-small-qa (lower cost, fast)
- mix-med-rerank (balanced accuracy)
- llm-compat-large (higher quality, higher latency)

We'll demo fallback to a quantized variant and show regional routing to an EU replica for sovereignty tests.

-Mina
